artifacts.minimum_depth: Every material official, filing, market, broker and failed-probe source is registered.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: A high-impact claim lacks a registered source or weak evidence is upgraded.
artifacts.verifier_check: source registry and JSON twin present

artifacts.minimum_depth: Audit every named customer, order, capacity, ASP, utilization, margin and BD claim.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Unaudited material claim supports core status, EPS or valuation.
artifacts.verifier_check: claim audit and JSON twin present

artifacts.minimum_depth: All semiconductor, innovative-drug and power-equipment modules include listed, overseas/private, demand-anchor, low-purity and unavailable nodes where relevant.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Mandatory block missing or universe reduced to a concept list.

artifacts.artifact: analysis/supply_chain_model.md; analysis/company_fundamental_cards.md; analysis/value_chain_economics.md; analysis/chain_earnings_bridge.md; data/supply_chain_relationships.md/json; data/customer_chain_audit.md/json
artifacts.minimum_depth: Every covered ticker has relationship and economics evidence or an explicit watchlist downgrade.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Generic demand or chain participation supports EPS or valuation.

artifacts.minimum_depth: One source-quality-labelled row for every core ticker; not-found rows are explicit.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Incomplete core coverage without downgrade or weak evidence receives valuation weight.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Every AI/order/ASP-dependent core candidate gets a driver bridge or a watchlist downgrade.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: High-growth valuation credit lacks an earnings bridge.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Each investable ticker has business-model-matched primary and secondary methods, market/Street reconciliation and disclosed scenario math.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Missing current-price target/range, method mismatch, unreconciled arithmetic or no Model Reproducibility PASS.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Chinese prose-led chapters and readable sourced exhibits.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Table-only core chapters, missing valuation summary, untranslated recommendation logic or render defects.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Independent maker-checker review and closure lifecycle at every gate.
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Open S/unwaived A, score below 90, failed verifier or sign-off conflict.
